startup.formula: PD + dev fitted-load holding -> +/-40Nm -> outward relative-torque projection
startup.input_source: same sampled/delayed low-level encoders as PD, before target winding

spring_feedforward.geometry_error_scope: sampled/delayed encoders against native slider before the same1ms interval; diagnostic, not force calibration or learned behavior

policy_observation_age.scope: Additional policy-frame age; calibrated 5.5/3.5ms wheel I/O delay is unchanged

native.loaded_torque_speed_curve: Explicit delivered prior; not identified under load
